---
applyTo: "research/**/*.md,configs/experiments/**/*.json,scripts/**/*.py"
---
# Research Instructions

- Follow docs/ai/experiment-protocol.md for all experiment changes.
- Use versioned experiment slugs in the format v<version>_<idea_slug>.
- Keep one primary variable change per experiment version.
- Record reproducibility metadata and artifact paths.
- Store negative results and failure analysis when outcomes are not improved.
